The PR description is self-contained so some pinged people don't have to read the whole thread -- but ofc invited to do so, with also the Lukasz created issue also mentioned in PR description.
I went a bit verbose in PR comments; doesn't mean needs strict review -- mainly wanted to leave some things clear, and help you (or your agents) to understand and double check understanding and implications for your codebase; and if this sounds like what we want to do moving forward.

(Note that `project/zkevm` already has merged https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3913 which is a slight modification of NewPayloadRequest SSZ to be aligned with Gloas; just mentioning to not be a red herring if you want to try fill and test with your client; also account for that. If you want, I can also provide the filled fixtures for these new tests (although an agent can do it easily for you), just lmk).

Can wait some days to get feedback since I know many of you will be in Devcon -- I'll be OOO next week anyway (not going to mumbai). 

If you check things out (no pressure if you can't!), LMK your feedback on how this pr feels! (i can wait for 2 or 3 people giving a thumbs up, might be enough)
